validation_commands: ls tests/ | head -20; find tests -maxdepth 2 -name "__init__.py" | head -5
for d in tests/*/; do [ -f "$d/__init__.py" ] || echo "no __init__: $d"; done
ls -d tests/*/ | while read d; do test -f "${d}__init__.py" || echo "no __init__: $d"; done

find tests -maxdepth 1 -type d -not -name __pycache__ -not -path tests | sort > /tmp/alldirs.txt; find tests -maxdepth 2 -name __init__.py -path "tests/*/__init__.py" | xargs -n1 dirname | sort > /tmp/initdirs.txt; comm -23 /tmp/alldirs.txt /tmp/initdirs.txt
find tests -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort | sed 's|$|/__init__.py|' | while read f; do test -f "$f" || echo "MISSING $f"; done
python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_quack_fp8_gate.py -m 'core_model and cpu' -q 2>&1 | tail -3
